First, note the given date: 03-18-1387 (MM-DD-YYYY).  
32 weeks + 6 days = (32 × 7) + 6 = 224 + 6 = 230 days.  

Add 230 days to 1387-03-18:  
March has 31 days, so days remaining in March after 18th: 13 days.  
230 − 13 = 217 days left to add.  
April (30) + May (31) + June (30) + July (31) + August (31) = 153 days.  
217 − 153 = 64 days left.  
September (30) leaves 34 days into October → October 34th → November 3rd (since Oct has 31 days: 34 − 31 = 3).  

Year remains 1387 (no year rollover because 230 days < 365).  

Final date: 1387-11-03.
